## TLDR for human
- Block installer and temporary-location launches before they can register a server.
- Retry launchd registration and migrate older same-home CLI services safely.
- Verify a clean-profile install and signed in-app update before publication.

---

### Fixed

- **Mac connection after installation.** Carbon asks you to move it to Applications
  before running from an installer or temporary macOS location. Its background
  server no longer gets registered to a disk image that disappears after ejecting.
- **Background server recovery.** A stopped login job pointing to an old app can
  be replaced without waiting for a connection it cannot answer. Initial
  registration and reloads retry if launchd is still unloading the old job.
- **Older CLI installations.** A previous CLI server sharing the app’s data
  folder is retired after it exits idle, so the two services cannot compete.
  Headless servers configured with their own data folder stay separate.

Includes carbon CLI 0.13.11. Universal macOS build for Apple silicon and Intel. This beta is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized.

Qualified on an existing Mac with isolated Carbon profiles: installer launch protection, clean-profile startup, launchd registration retry, safe legacy CLI-server migration, and a signed beta.3 → beta.4 update through the app with automatic relaunch and This Mac reconnection. Existing macOS permissions were not reset.

[Release checks](https://github.com/matthieu-pm/carbonhq/blob/v0.30.0-beta.4/apps/desktop/docs/release-checks-0.30.0-beta.4.md).
